title: hive daemon enable/disable output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive daemon enable PROJECT|--all --json` and `hive daemon disable PROJECT|--all --json`. Toggles `daemon.enabled` in each target's `<project>/.hive-state/config.yml` and reports per-project before/after values. The dispatcher picks the change up on its next poll (no SIGHUP required).

results.description: One entry per affected project. With PROJECT, length is 1; with --all, length matches the registry size.

next_action.description: OPTIONAL in v1. Present in the current producer's emission; absent from the original PR #45 v1 producer (which shipped before this field was added). Consumers MUST tolerate its absence on this version. A future v2 may make it required.

kind.description: no_op = nothing changed (every result was already at the requested state). reload = at least one project flipped; reload is OPTIONAL because the dispatcher's per-tick cache invalidation picks up the change within poll_interval_sec.

command.description: Concrete shell command an agent can run for this next_action. Present only when kind=reload.

required.description: True if the next_action MUST be executed for the change to take effect; false if it's a hint that speeds up convergence. Always false for kind=reload (per-tick cache picks up within poll_interval_sec). Present only when kind=reload.

path.description: Absolute path of the project root.

previous.description: Prior value of daemon.enabled. null when the daemon block (or the enabled key) was absent before this call.

current.description: New value of daemon.enabled after the rewrite (true for enable, false for disable).

config_yml.description: Absolute path of the per-project config.yml that was rewritten.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised. Matches every other hive-* error envelope.

error_kind.description: missing_project = PROJECT positional missing without --all. unknown_project = PROJECT not in registry. project_and_all = both PROJECT and --all were passed. not_initialised = project registered but its .hive-state/config.yml is missing. no_projects = --all but registry empty. config = malformed config.yml (exit 78). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 70).
